title: PARADIS IT — Masterclass 600 Jours
summary: A 600-day self-paced IT/cybersecurity training curriculum delivered as Markdown lessons with an AI tutor, covering topics from Linux to AI/ML and MLOps. Several lesson files (jour-246, jour-273, jour-486) teach learners to build a synthetic-data generation script using SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, and evaluate_quality to fabricate anonymized customer/banking data and score its statistical fidelity.
needs: Code appears as embedded lesson snippets within Markdown docs; unclear if actually executed/tested as part of the repo's CI rather than purely illustrative teaching material.
